display.purpose: Product identity in the console header.

title.purpose: Recovery-stage values and compact operational titles.

label.purpose: Small uppercase status, telemetry, and workflow labels.

motion.name: telemetry-width
motion.purpose: Smooth utilization-bar updates between two-second telemetry samples.

motion.name: telemetry-color
motion.purpose: Changes utilization-bar severity without distracting movement.

motion.name: control-state
motion.value: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses transitions and animations when the operating system requests reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Decisive bounded actions such as stopping an active simulation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--green, #58d39b); border-radius: 5px; background: var(--green, #58d39b); color: #04100c; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 720; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #70dfaa; border-color: #70dfaa; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #58d39b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--green, #58d39b); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .45; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default action treatment for routine operator controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 38px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #285055); border-radius: 5px; background: #0e2022; color: var(--text, #e6efed); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 620; transition: border-color 140ms ease, background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--green, #58d39b); background: var(--surface-hover, #112226); color: var(--green, #58d39b); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #58d39b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: var(--surface, #091315); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: .45; }

components.name: Status Surface
components.description: Current risk, monitoring context, and provenance in one bounded row.
components.html:
CURRENT RISK
LOW
Live host monitoring
All resource measurements are real
MEASURED DATA
components.css: .ds-status { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px 1fr auto; gap: 1rem; align-items: center; padding: .72rem .85rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #1b3437); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface, #091315); color: var(--text, #e6efed); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-label { color: var(--quiet, #78908c); font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .085em; } .ds-status-value { margin-top: .14rem; color: var(--green, #58d39b); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 720; } .ds-status-context { font-size: .86rem; font-weight: 630; } .ds-status-detail { margin-top: .12rem; color: var(--muted, #8da3a0); font-size: .76rem; } .ds-status-tag { padding: .32rem .58rem; border: 1px solid #285a47; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--green, #58d39b); font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: .065em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-status:focus-within { border-color: var(--green, #58d39b); } @media (max-width: 800px) { .ds-status { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: .8rem; } .ds-status-tag { width: fit-content; } }

components.name: Telemetry Cell
components.description: Compact resource reading with a state-colored utilization track.
components.css: .ds-telemetry { min-width: 0; padding: .85rem .9rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #1b3437); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface, #091315); font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-telemetry-label { color: var(--quiet, #78908c); font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .085em; } .ds-telemetry-value { margin: .42rem 0 .6rem; color: var(--text, #e6efed); font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 680; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-telemetry-track { height: 3px; overflow: hidden; background: #16282b; } .ds-telemetry-track span { display: block; width: 42.6%; height: 100%; background: var(--green, #58d39b); transition: width 240ms ease-out, background-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-telemetry:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #285055); } .ds-telemetry:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #58d39b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Recovery Stage
components.description: One policy, execution, or verification step in the auditable recovery sequence.
components.css: .ds-recovery-stage { min-height: 132px; padding: .85rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #1b3437); border-radius: 7px; background: #0b1b17; font-family: "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stage-step { color: var(--quiet, #78908c); font-size: .66rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .085em; } .ds-stage-title { margin-top: .62rem; color: var(--muted, #8da3a0); font-size: .76rem; } .ds-stage-value { margin-top: .18rem; color: var(--text, #e6efed); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 680; } .ds-stage-detail { margin-top: .45rem; color: var(--muted, #8da3a0); font-size: .76rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-recovery-stage:hover { border-color: var(--line-strong, #285055); } .ds-recovery-stage:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #58d39b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Source Tag
components.description: A compact provenance label for measured or mixed operational data.
components.css: .ds-source-tag { display: inline-block; padding: .32rem .58rem; border: 1px solid #285a47; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--green, #58d39b); background: transparent; font: 650 .68rem/1.2 "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .065em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-source-tag:hover { border-color: var(--green, #58d39b); } .ds-source-tag:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #58d39b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-source-tag:active { background: #0b1b17; }

components.name: Console Tabs
components.description: Compact horizontal navigation for the seven operating views.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab-active">Fleet overview</button><button class="ds-tab">Detection</button><button class="ds-tab">Recovery</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0; overflow-x: auto; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #1b3437); scrollbar-width: thin; } .ds-tab { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 .9rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #8da3a0); font: 400 .75rem/1.2 "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text, #e6efed); background: #0a1516; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green, #58d39b); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-tab:active, .ds-tab-active { border-bottom-color: var(--green, #58d39b); background: #0a1516; color: var(--green, #58d39b); }

narrative.overview:
DisasterOS feels like a purpose-built control room viewed during a long operating shift: low-glare, compact, calm under normal load, and unmistakable when conditions worsen. Near-black surfaces, precise separators, dense telemetry, and tabular numerals keep attention on evidence rather than decoration.

The interface is flat and operational. Green marks healthy state and primary action, blue appears only for comparative data, and amber or red communicates escalating risk. Generic AI gloss, decorative gradients, excessive rounding, and pictorial emoji are outside the visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy-black canvas with restrained teal-toned surface layering.
Dense, scan-first telemetry with compact labels and tabular figures.
Semantic color that stays quiet until state or comparison requires it.
Fine borders and short transitions instead of shadows or ornamental effects.
Responsive reflow at 800px with motion reduced at the operating-system preference.

rules.name: The Semantic Signal Rule
rules.body: Green communicates health and primary action; blue is reserved for comparison; amber and red are reserved for escalating operational state.

rules.name: The Low-Glare Rule
rules.body: Large areas remain near-black or dark teal; bright colors appear on readings, state, focus, and compact controls rather than as decorative fields.

rules.name: The Readings First Rule
rules.body: Use tabular numerals for telemetry and metrics so changing values remain aligned and easy to compare.

rules.name: The Compact Label Rule
rules.body: Operational labels are small, uppercase, tracked, and subordinate to the value they identify.

rules.name: The Flat Console Rule
rules.body: Surfaces remain flat at rest and in interaction; use tonal layering and borders, never drop shadows, to establish hierarchy.

dos: Do keep the canvas deep navy-black and use fine teal structural lines to organize dense information.
Do reserve green for healthy state, focus, progress, active navigation, and primary action.
Do use blue only when a comparative data series needs separation from the green primary series.
Do present changing measurements with tabular numerals and compact uppercase labels.
Do preserve the 800px reflow and the reduced-motion override when extending the interface.
donts: Don't add gradients, glows, glass effects, drop shadows, or decorative visual noise.
Don't use oversized type, inflated whitespace, or large rounded cards that dilute console density.
Don't use emojis or generic decorative icons as status communication.
Don't use amber or red decoratively; they are operational warnings.
Don't turn every datum into an isolated floating card when a shared instrument surface communicates the relationship more clearly.
